subject: CloudAlly technical engagement — scheduling technical deep-dive and alignment
messages:
From: Gina Park <gina.park@cloudally.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>; Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>; Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Paul Scott <pscott@enterpriseprospect.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CloudAlly x Redwood — follow-up & next technical deep-dive

Thanks again for the time this morning — quick recap from our discovery and a request to lock the next technical session.

Recap (high level):
- Prospect (EnterpriseProspect Inc.) is evaluating marketplace-led provisioning for LLM inference and needs a private offering in their AWS org.
- Key asks: predictable per-request latency SLA, VPC peering pattern, and SOC2 evidence for onboarding.
- Expected ramp: pilot (50-100 qps) -> month 3 expansion (300+ qps).

Immediate next step: schedule a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive to cover network topology, auth/KMS flow, and a short run-through of model variants.

Suggested attendee list: CloudAlly solution engineers (Matt + me), Redwood product/infra (Mina, Camila, Marcus), and the EnterpriseProspect security/infra lead (Paul).

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue Oct 12, 10:00–11:30
- Wed Oct 13, 14:00–15:30

I attached a short "MVP requirements" PDF and a proposed agenda to help scope the session. Please confirm which slot works or propose alternatives.

Attachments: cloudally_mvp_requirements.pdf, proposed_agenda.docx

Thanks,
Gina Park
Senior Partner Solutions Manager | CloudAlly
T: 415-555-0147
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Gina Park <gina.park@cloudally.com>; Matt O'Neal <matt.oneal@cloudally.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudAlly x Redwood — follow-up & next technical deep-dive

Gina — really helpful recap, thanks. Quick answers and a couple of qualifiers before we lock time: 

- Throughput: pilot target of 50–100 qps sounds right for the evaluation. For sizing, can you confirm expected average sequence length and peak concurrent requests? That will determine whether we recommend 1 or 2 dedicated pools for the pilot.
- Data residency: EnterpriseProspect requires AWS us-west-2 only during pilot; good to confirm that marketplace provisioning can be pinned to that region.

We can run the 90-minute dive. Of the slots you proposed, Tue Oct 12 10:00 PT works for our infra lead (Marcus) and me. If that works for CloudAlly and EnterpriseProspect, let's lock it.

Attendees from Redwood: Mina (product), Camila (solutions), Marcus (platform). Sergio from infra may join for deeper network questions — I'll loop him in if we get confirmation.

If Tue 10:00 PT is good, send the calendar invite and any pre-reads you'd like the SEs to review. Also, if you can drop a short network/connectivity checklist (ports, NAT, proxy expectations) that'd speed setup.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Partner Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Matt O'Neal <matt.oneal@cloudally.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>; Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Gina Park <gina.park@cloudally.com>; Paul Scott <pscott@enterpriseprospect.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudAlly x Redwood — follow-up & next technical deep-dive

Thanks — Tue Oct 12 10:00 PT is good for us. Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=cldly-tech-dive-20261012 (I've tentatively placed a 90-min slot).

I've attached a short connectivity checklist (connectivity-checklist.xlsx) and dropped a Miro board with a preliminary diagram for the topology we'll cover: https://miro.com/app/board/uXjV-example/

On sequence lengths — EnterpriseProspect noted the majority of calls will be short (avg 32 tokens) but with a tail for longer context during session replays. We'll surface sample payloads in the drive before the meeting.

If you want, Gina and I can run a 20-minute pre-call with your infra person to validate firewall/NAT expectations earlier in the week (Thu Oct 7 or Fri Oct 8).

Attachments: connectivity-checklist.xlsx

—Matt
Matt O'Neal
Senior Solutions Engineer | CloudAlly
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 07 Oct 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fw: CloudAlly x Redwood — follow-up & next technical deep-dive

Sergio / Marcus — forwarding the chain. 

Sergio — can you own the network run-through and bring the baseline NAT/peering checklist? Matt suggested a quick pre-call Thu Oct 7 / Fri Oct 8 — if you can do a 20-min touch with Matt on Oct 8 at 09:00 PT that would be ideal.

Marcus — please be ready to speak to dedup/caching strategies and how we would size a pilot pool given avg seq length ~32 tokens + tail.

I'll accept the calendar invite once we have Sergio confirmed.

Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
